matching: If a path matches more than one tier's globs, the most restrictive tier applies: human-required > review-required > auto-safe.

human-required.description: Agent CANNOT modify without a human. Release-controlling, credential-handling, irreversible, or self-referential. Every path here must also be owned in CODEOWNERS, so GitHub holds the gate.

review-required.description: Retired in ADLC-3: kept empty on purpose. A path is either auto-safe (CI, the code review and the blast-radius gate decide) or human-required (owned in CODEOWNERS, a human merges).

auto-safe.description: Agent can freely modify. On paths no CODEOWNERS rule owns, auto-merge eligible. An owned path always waits for its code owner.
